timing.basis: Timing supplied by the root coordinating agent; no profile or analysis output was inspected to establish this timing.

original_frozen_protocol.allocation_verbatim: At least one per nonempty stratum; remaining quota proportional to remaining stratum capacity with largest-remainder allocation; cap at N_h. Take the entire eligible frame if <=2000.

audit_scope.inputs: Only frozen stratum sizes and quotas, protocol and execution seals, data code, and provenance/verification/release manifests.

comparison_definition.N: Sum of N_h in the frozen source sampling-design JSON.
comparison_definition.H: Number of nonempty strata in that same file.
comparison_definition.planned_allocation: If N <= 2000, planned_n_h = N_h. Otherwise allocate one to each nonempty stratum, then distribute R=target_n-H across remaining capacities C_h=N_h-1: a_h=R*C_h/(N-H), start at 1+floor(a_h), and award the remaining slots by descending fractional remainder; exact ties use ascending lexical stratum_id. Enforce planned_n_h <= N_h.
comparison_definition.planned_arithmetic: Exact integer divmod; independently checked with fractions.Fraction, avoiding floating-point tie ambiguity.
comparison_definition.implemented_allocation: proportional_quotas computes ideal_h=target_n*N_h/N, initializes q_h=min(N_h,max(1,floor(ideal_h))), then removes excess quota or adds remaining slots relative to ideal_h. It does not reserve one first and allocate target_n-H against N_h-1. N <= 2000 returns the entire frame.
comparison_definition.actual_n_h: Recorded n_h from the frozen sampling-design JSON, verified by executing only the isolated unmodified proportional_quotas function on the same N_h values.
comparison_definition.minimum_reassigned_slots: L1/2 because planned and actual total sample sizes agree; this is a quota distance, not an executed reassignment or an estimate of statistical-effect impact.
comparison_definition.within_stratum_selection: Unchanged frozen ascending SHA256 order; no person identities or rows were selected, replaced or inspected for this comparison.

interpretation.finding: Brazil quotas differ from the declared reserve-one-then-apportion-remaining-capacity rule. OGDB and ADB agree because their complete eligible source frames are below 2000.
interpretation.conditional_weight_scope: Weights N_h/actual_n_h describe the actual eligible-source sampling allocation under the stated within-stratum selection mechanism. They do not erase the preregistration discrepancy, convert a deterministic hash sample into an externally randomized design, or make source selection globally representative.
interpretation.remaining_limits: An eligible-source-frame calculation is not a probability sample of all national births or the global population. This audit evaluates quota implementation only; it makes no claim about the size or direction of effects on scores, test statistics, p-values or conclusions.
interpretation.handling: Preserve the frozen protocol, code, source inputs, realized samples and models. Disclose the allocation deviation alongside any subsequent source-specific statistical analysis; do not silently relabel the implementation as exact protocol compliance.
